answer: Pick the smallest edge that still discriminates. Trust edges halve every 12 months, a split verdict dilutes the payout by 0.5, and credit attaches to the task rather than the address. That is 1 edge, 2 years, 0 carry-over. A developer filing a timber count, a nadir reading and a wander track keeps one live edge per counterparty. A farm has to refresh 10,000 edges every year, and dilution eats the margin before renewal does.
